name: DesignGrid AI Descriptions for WooCommerce
author: p421432

sections.description:
DesignGrid AI Descriptions for WooCommerce connects your WooCommerce store to OpenAI to generate professional product copy in seconds.

Key Features

  • One-Click Generation – Generate title, short description, full description, and SEO meta in one click.
  • Bulk Generation – Select multiple products and generate copy for all of them at once.
  • Tone Control – Choose from 6 tones: Professional, Casual & Friendly, Luxury & Premium, Technical, Playful, Minimalist.
  • SEO-Ready Output – Descriptions structured for search engines with keyword integration and compelling CTAs.
  • Keyword Input – Provide optional keywords and the plugin will naturally weave them into the copy.
  • Multi-Language Support – Generate descriptions in any language supported by OpenAI.
  • BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) – Works with your own OpenAI API key. No monthly subscriptions.
  • Model Selector – Choose gpt-4o-mini (recommended), gpt-4o, gpt-4-turbo, or gpt-3.5-turbo.

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8+
  • WooCommerce 6.0+
  • PHP 7.4+
  • An OpenAI API key (https://platform.openai.com)

External Services

This plugin connects to the OpenAI API to generate AI-powered product descriptions for WooCommerce products.

It is needed to generate automatic product titles, short descriptions, and long descriptions using artificial intelligence.

When the user clicks the generate button inside the WordPress admin dashboard, the plugin sends the following data to OpenAI:

  • Product title
  • Product category (if available)
  • Product short description (if available)
  • Custom prompt provided by the store admin
  • API request metadata required for processing

No customer personal data is sent.

This service is provided by OpenAI:

Terms of Service:
https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/

Privacy Policy:
https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin in WordPress > Plugins.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > AI Descriptions and enter your OpenAI API key.
  4. Open any WooCommerce product and use the AI Generator panel.
sections.faq:
Do I need to pay for a subscription?

No. This is a one-time purchase. You only pay OpenAI for your own API usage.

Which OpenAI models are supported?

gpt-4o-mini (recommended), gpt-4o, gpt-4-turbo, and gpt-3.5-turbo.

Can I generate in languages other than English?

Yes. Set your preferred language in WooCommerce > AI Descriptions > Output Language.
